simple.meaning: תְּאוֹ (tᵉʼôw) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H8377. teo תְּאוֺ noun masculine antelope (whether antilope leucoryx Tr NHB 59; FFP 5 , or oryx beatrix Post Hast. DB Ox ; on form see Ol § 173 g ); — absolute ׳ת Deut 14:5 (clean animal, compare Dr); construct תּוֺא Isa 51:20 . תַּאֲוָה see תוה , I. אוה . תְּאָלָה see II. אלה . p. 16, 46, 1063 תאם (Buhl after Ba NB § 182 b proposes III. agree as √ of following, but dubious; see Assyrian tu'âmu, Arabic , Syriac , all twin ).
